turns.prompt:
You are given one attached CSV file:
  - cdft_piezo_pool.csv: 100 CANDIDATE crystalline materials whose
    properties are NOT given, columns `candidate_id`, `formula` and `poscar`
    (the crystal structure, in POSCAR format).

No property values are provided. Using your knowledge of crystal chemistry,
crystal symmetry and structure-property relationships, predict which
candidates have the LARGEST piezoelectric strain coefficient max|d_ij| (in
pC/N), then select the 5 best candidates from the pool.

Reason from the structures, then end your answer with an explicit ranked
list of candidate_ids, best first, e.g. "Final: c901, c902, c903, c904,
c905".
turns.answer_text:
The piezoelectric strain tensor \(d_{ij}\) vanishes identically in any structure possessing inversion symmetry. Among the non-centrosymmetric candidates the magnitude of \(\max|d_{ij}|\) is controlled by the ratio of the piezoelectric stress constants \(e_{ij}\) to the elastic stiffnesses \(C_{ijkl}\). Consequently the largest responses occur in the softest polar crystals (molecular or hydrogen-bonded molecular solids held by van der Waals or weak hydrogen-bond contacts).  

Inspection of the 100 POSCARs identifies five such compounds:  
- SF4 (c092) contains a single polar molecule per cell and therefore a polar space group; the lattice is a typical molecular van-der-Waals packing.  
- GeH3Cl (c029) contains two aligned polar molecules; the resulting crystal dipole and the equally weak intermolecular contacts produce an even larger compliance.  
- Hf(BH4)4 (c078) is a tetrahedral molecular crystal (non-centrosymmetric cubic packing).  
- H3F2 (c051) and RbH3O2 (c010) are hydrogen-bonded molecular/ionic-molecular solids whose elastic moduli remain far below those of three-dimensional covalent or oxide frameworks.  

All ordinary tetrahedral semiconductors, chalcopyrites, wurtzites and oxide perovskites present in the pool are stiffer by one to two orders of magnitude and therefore cannot compete. The five molecular crystals listed above are consequently predicted to exhibit the highest \(\max|d_{ij}|\).

Final: c092, c029, c078, c051, c010
